explanationMd: Take the cube root of 64, which is 4, then square it to obtain 16. For a positive base, the fractional exponent has this unambiguous interpretation.

distractorRationale.a: This takes the cube root but omits squaring.
distractorRationale.d: This multiplies 64 by a simple fraction instead of exponentiating.
distractorRationale.e: This squares after an incorrect root step.
distractorRationale.b: This takes only the square root, not the specified power.
